decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a  single-storey rear extension to 86 The Drive would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding area, and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV- B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan,and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match the pebbledash used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
